preprocessing: BGR, NCHW, height 48, aspect-preserving bilinear resize, (pixel/255 - 0.5)/0.5, right padding zero in normalized space
decoding: CTC blank 0, dictionary at indices 1..18383, appended space at 18384; collapse consecutive identical indices; no word lexicon
status: Experimental debug-only line recognizer; phone accuracy and runtime are not yet measured
